note: Bundled model catalogue, read by harness/lib/model-catalogue.mjs and served by the console's /api/models. It is a STARTING list, never an authority: a lab can ship a model an hour after this file is committed. Regenerate it with `node --env-file=.env harness/scripts/refresh-model-catalogue.mjs`, which lists every lab you hold a key for and rewrites this file with real release dates. A connected repository's own .agent/model-snapshot.json always takes precedence in the console, because it was written with that project's keys and is current.
sourceDetail: Seeded from models this harness has actually called and recorded, not from a live /models listing: docs/campaigns/2026-09-11-first-real-campaigns.md and the generation records beneath docs/campaigns/2026-09-11/. Release dates are unknown for these entries, so they carry none.
